conversion: Full source f/g near surfaces: no leaf, twig or wood omission/simplification. Far source leaf/twig UV triangle unions are individually masked into 16 unused 80x160 atlas tiles, 4px padding, 4x supersampling in linear light. Per-component UV-to-XYZ least-squares panels approximate distant curvature; native near UV is unchanged. Far wood welds only coincident positions and averages its bark UV/normals, retaining every component, physical boundary and locked root. Source RGB8/L8 alpha. No random removal or diameter-only support pruning.
